Project rule:
In a SQLAlchemy async backfill script, when the task says to verify something and abort
instead of committing, the check must run BEFORE the data is made permanent. Call
`db.flush()` on the AsyncSession so the verification query can see the pending changes,
run the check, `db.rollback()` and raise if it fails, and only `db.commit()` once the
check has passed. A commit followed by a check has nothing left to prevent.

Write python code that follows this rule. Output only code.
